detail_text: For PAU rice varieties other than PR 132: N 42, P2O5 12 and K2O 12 kg/acre; the source lists neem-coated urea 90 kg, DAP 27 kg or single superphosphate 75 kg, and MOP 20 kg/acre. It divides N into three equal applications: within 7 days of transplanting, 21 DAT, then 35 DAT for PR 126 or 42 DAT for other varieties.
applicability_conditions: Regional Punjab rice reference only. P and K remain conditional on the source's soil-test provisions; the crop variety, observed stage, prior application and field soil test are not recorded here.
non_action_boundary: This is a source-recorded regional schedule, not permission to issue an individual field dose.

source_location: PDF pp. 14-15 stem-borer ETL and p. 17 sheath-blight action
detail_text: For rice stem borer, the source records a more-than-5%-dead-hearts threshold and chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC at 60 mL/acre in 100 L water, with repetition only if damage again reaches that threshold. For sheath blight, it first records residue/bund management and avoiding excessive nitrogen; where the disease appears at maximum tillering to boot stage, it records propiconazole 25% EC at 200 mL/acre in 200 L water, with a second spray only when required after 15 days.
applicability_conditions: The applicable problem, threshold or diagnosis, crop stage and field condition are not recorded by this scenario. These are conditional IPM/treatment references, never a calendar spray.
non_action_boundary: Do not interpret either source-recorded option as a treatment order.

detail_text: For Punjab medium-fertility wheat, the source records N 50 and P2O5 25 kg/acre; it lists neem-coated urea 110 kg and DAP 55 kg or single superphosphate 155 kg/acre. K2O is only for a documented low-K soil: 12 kg/acre (20 kg MOP), except 24 kg K2O/acre in Gurdaspur, Hoshiarpur, Rupnagar and SBS Nagar. The source places P and any K at sowing and urea at the first and second irrigation.
applicability_conditions: Regional medium-fertility reference only. Soil-K status, actual sowing, irrigation, crop stage and prior nutrient application are not recorded by this scenario.
non_action_boundary: This is a source-recorded regional schedule, not permission to issue an individual field dose.

detail_text: For confirmed yellow/stripe rust, PAU records resistant varieties, monitoring from the second week of December and initial spot treatment around infected patches. It records propiconazole 25% EC at 200 mL/acre in 200 L water as soon as disease is noticed, initially around infected patches, with repetition only as needed.
applicability_conditions: A dated yellow-rust diagnosis, observed crop stage, infected-patch status and field condition are not recorded by this scenario.
non_action_boundary: This source-recorded option is conditional IPM context, not a treatment order.

source_location: PDF p. 390 Tamil Nadu maize NPK branches for varieties and hybrids
detail_text: For Tamil Nadu maize varieties, the source records N:P2O5:K2O = 135:62.5:50 kg/ha; for hybrids it records 250:75:75 kg/ha. It also records TNAU micronutrient mixture at 30 kg/ha as enriched FYM, prepared at a 1:10 micronutrient-mixture:FYM ratio, or 12.5 kg of the Department of Agriculture micronutrient mixture.
applicability_conditions: The scenario does not record whether the crop is a variety or hybrid, actual crop stage, field soil test, FYM availability or previous nutrient application; no branch may be inferred.
non_action_boundary: These are source-recorded regional branches, not an individual field dose.

detail_text: The TNAU fall-armyworm page records neem cake at 250 kg/ha at last ploughing, cyantraniliprole 19.8% plus thiamethoxam 19.8% FS seed treatment at 4 mL/kg seed, border crops, and FAW pheromone traps at 12/ha. For an observed early FAW stage (15-20 DAE), it records azadirachtin 1500 ppm at 2.5 L/ha or chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC at 200 mL/ha or flubendiamide 480 SC at 250 mL/ha. For observed late whorl stage (35-40 DAE), it records Metarhizium anisopliae at 2.5 kg/ha or emamectin benzoate 5 SG at 200 g/ha or novaluron 10 EC at 750 mL/ha or spinetoram 11.7 SC at 250 mL/ha.
applicability_conditions: The scenario contains no FAW diagnosis, observed larval stage, crop age, threshold event, field condition or label-use decision. The page's stage-specific options remain conditional.
non_action_boundary: This is source-recorded IPM context, not a preventive or curative treatment order.

source_location: PDF p. 315 Maharashtra chickpea basal NPK
detail_text: For Maharashtra chickpea, the source records N:P2O5:K2O = 25:50:25 kg/ha as basal at sowing. It differentiates rainfed and irrigated sowing windows and seed-rate branches by desi or Kabuli type.
applicability_conditions: This scenario does not record sowing, desi/Kabuli type, water regime, field soil test, secondary/micronutrient status or actual crop stage.
non_action_boundary: This is a source-recorded regional basal reference, not an individual field dose.

detail_text: For Helicoverpa/pod borer at the documented economic threshold, the source requires pheromone traps and an NSKE spray before recording a chemical option. It records quinalphos 25% EC at 20 mL/10 L water as an ETL-based option; the aligned PPQS record lists Bengal gram pod borer for quinalphos 25% EC at 1,000 mL/ha in 500-1,000 L water.
applicability_conditions: No dated pod-borer diagnosis, economic-threshold observation, trap result, NSKE prerequisite, crop stage or field condition is recorded by this scenario.
non_action_boundary: This is source-recorded conditional IPM context, not a pesticide order.

source_location: PDF p. 2 central-zone NPKS at sowing
detail_text: For ICAR-IISR Central Zone soybean, the source records N:P2O5:K2O:S = 25:60:40:20 kg/ha, all at sowing. It lists source combinations of 56 kg urea plus 375-400 kg SSP plus 67 kg MOP; or 140 kg DAP plus 67 kg MOP plus 25 kg bentonite sulphur; or 200 kg 12:32:16 plus 25 kg bentonite sulphur per hectare. It specifies a seed-cum-fertilizer drill or broadcasting before sowing and says not to mix fertilizer with seed.
applicability_conditions: Only the documented Central Zone states are in scope. Actual sowing, soil test, soil sulphur status, fertilizer availability, crop stage and prior application are not recorded.
non_action_boundary: This is a source-recorded regional sowing reference, not an individual field dose.

source_location: PDF pp. 47 and 49 ETL-based defoliator option
detail_text: For soybean defoliators, the source records economic thresholds of green semilooper at 4 larvae/m row at flowering or 3 larvae/m at podding, and tobacco caterpillar at 10 larvae/m before flowering. It records chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC at 150 mL/ha for these source-defined defoliator cases; the aligned PPQS record lists the same formulation for soybean green semilooper and tobacco caterpillar at 150 mL/ha.
applicability_conditions: No dated pest diagnosis, species confirmation, larval count, crop stage, threshold event or field condition is recorded by this scenario.
non_action_boundary: This is source-recorded conditional IPM context, not an insecticide order.

source_location: PDF p. 1 hybrid tomato drip-fertigation schedule
detail_text: For hybrid tomato under the source's drip-fertigation system, total N:P2O5:K2O is 200:250:250 kg/ha. The source applies 75% P2O5 (187.5 kg/ha, stated as 1,172 kg superphosphate) as basal, then fertigates remaining N:P2O5:K2O = 200:62.5:250 kg/ha once every three days across transplanting-establishment (10 days), flower initiation-flowering (30 days), flowering-fruit set (30 days), and alternate days from picking (80 days).
applicability_conditions: The scenario does not record hybrid status, drip-fertigation availability, actual transplanting date, crop stage, field soil test or previous application.
non_action_boundary: This is a source-recorded conditional regional schedule, not an individual field dose.

It records azoxystrobin 18.2% plus difenoconazole 11.4% SC at 200 mL/acre; the aligned PPQS record lists the same formulation for tomato early and late blight.
applicability_conditions: No dated early-blight diagnosis, disease severity, crop stage, field condition or label-use decision is recorded by this scenario.
